items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，称其为最强大模型或接近 AGI
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra, Says Its Most Capable Model Yet Might Be AGI
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 正式推出新一代旗舰模型 GPT-6 Astra，并称这是公司迄今为止能力最强的模型，甚至可能达到通用人工智能（AGI）的水平。不过，该消息目前仅有简要发布信息，模型的具体技术参数、可用性与部署细节尚未披露。作为 GPT 系列的重要迭代，GPT-6 Astra 被视为 OpenAI 在通往 AGI 道路上的一次关键布局。若其宣称属实，将可能重塑 AI 产业格局，并引发关于 AI 安全与监管的新一轮讨论。由于缺少更多细节，实际表现仍有待后续评估。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra, Says Its Most Capable Model Yet Might Be AGI blockhead.co
items.why_zh: GPT-6 Astra 若真达到接近 AGI 的水平，或将再次刷新行业能力上限，并加速 AI 治理讨论。
items.why_en: If GPT-6 Astra truly approaches AGI, it could redefine AI capability limits and intensify debates on AI governance.

items.title_zh: Phonely 推出语音 LLM Alma，称比 OpenAI 快63%、便宜84%
items.title_en: Phonely Launches Alma, a Voice LLM That’s 63% Faster and 84% Cheaper Than OpenAI
items.summary_zh: 语音通信领域公司 Phonely 发布了名为 Alma 的语音大语言模型（LLM），声称其运行速度比 OpenAI 的同类产品快 63%，成本则低 84%。Alma 主要面向语音交互场景，旨在以更低成本和更低延迟提供语音 AI 能力。这一对比基于 Phonely 的公开宣称，实际产品在不同负载和任务下的表现尚未得到第三方验证。若数据属实，Alma 将在客服、语音助手等对成本和延迟敏感的应用中构成竞争威胁。由于具体基准和对比对象未详细说明，市场仍需谨慎看待。
items.summary_en: Phonely Launches Alma, a Voice LLM That’s 63% Faster and 84% Cheaper Than OpenAI CustomerThink
items.why_zh: 更快的速度和更低成本是语音 AI 落地的关键痛点，Alma 的出现可能推动行业重新定价。
items.why_en: Speed and cost are key pain points for voice AI; Alma's claims could push the industry toward better pricing and performance.

items.title_zh: 努比亚NaviX Ultra定于9月16日发布，搭载豆包手机助手
items.title_en: Nubia NaviX Ultra Set for September 16 Launch with Doubao Phone Assistant
items.summary_zh: 努比亚NaviX Ultra定于9月16日发布，搭载豆包手机助手 动点科技
items.summary_en: Nubia has scheduled the launch of its new NaviX Ultra flagship for September 16, with built-in integration of the Doubao phone assistant. The device will leverage ByteDance's Doubao AI model to offer assistant capabilities. Further specs and features will be revealed at launch, highlighting the growing tie-up between smartphone makers and AI providers.
items.why_zh: 手机厂商直接捆绑热门国产 AI 助手，标志着端侧 AI 应用进入新的落地阶段。
items.why_en: The integration of a mainstream AI assistant into a flagship phone signals a new phase in on-device AI adoption.

items.title_zh: 通义千问开源自动驾驶模型Qwen-Drive-1.0
items.title_en: Tongyi Qianwen Open-Sources Autonomous Driving Model Qwen-Drive-1.0
items.summary_zh: 通义千问开源自动驾驶模型Qwen-Drive-1.0 动点科技
items.summary_en: Alibaba's Tongyi Qianwen team has open-sourced Qwen-Drive-1.0, a model designed for autonomous driving scenarios. Developers and automakers can now access and fine-tune it for driving-related tasks, potentially lowering R&D barriers. Details such as model architecture and evaluation metrics are yet to be published.
items.why_zh: 开源自动驾驶专用模型有望降低智驾研发门槛，推动大模型在垂直场景的规模化落地。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing a driving-specific model could democratize autonomous driving R&D and push LLMs into vertical applications.

items.title_zh: “豆包手机”，9月16日正式发布
items.title_en: 'Doubao Phone' Officially Launches on September 16
items.summary_zh: “豆包手机”，9月16日正式发布 新浪财经
items.summary_en: According to Sina Finance, the much-anticipated 'Doubao Phone' will be officially released on September 16. Specific hardware specs and brand details remain undisclosed. The device is expected to deeply integrate ByteDance's Doubao AI assistant, marking ByteDance's foray into smart hardware.
items.why_zh: “豆包手机”若落地，标志着 AI 助手公司从软件走向自有硬件终端。
items.why_en: A Doubao-branded phone would signal ByteDance's move from software AI assistants to proprietary hardware.

items.title_zh: 飞利浦首款定制屏显剃须刀发布：照片一键上屏，3099 元起
items.title_en: Philips Launches First Custom-Display Shaver: One-Tap Personal Photos, Starting at 3099 Yuan

items.summary_en: Philips today launched its first shaver with a customizable display screen, the 9-series Ultra edition, starting at 3,099 yuan. Users can turn photos into the boot interface through the Philips men's grooming app. The device features micro-lift-and-cut technology, a micro-bead-coated head, and SkinIQ Pro pressure sensing for a smoother, more personalized shave.
items.why_zh: 该产品首次把可定制屏显引入剃须刀，结合AI传感与高端刀头，代表个护产品正在向个性化与智能化升级。
items.why_en: It marks the first time a shaver offers customizable display imagery, combining AI-powered sensing and premium blades to push personal care toward greater personalization.

items.title_zh: 英伟达 130亿美元收购 Hugging Face，被指利好欧洲开源 AI
items.title_en: NVIDIA Acquires Hugging Face for $13 Billion: A Boost for Europe's Open-Source AI
items.summary_zh: 据报道，英伟达（NVIDIA）将以 130 亿美元的价格收购人工智能模型平台 Hugging Face。Hugging Face 是开源 AI 社区的重要枢纽，托管大量预训练模型和数据集。此次收购若完成，将大幅增强英伟达在 AI 软件生态和开源社区中的话语权，并可能推动欧洲开源 AI 的发展，因为 Hugging Face 的欧洲背景和社区影响力将得到英伟达的算力支持。并购意义重大，但需经过监管审查。具体整合方式和对开源社区的影响仍有待观察。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA Acquires Hugging Face for $13 Billion: A Boost for Europe's Open-Source AI IndexBox
items.why_zh: 英伟达若拿下 Hugging Face，将从芯片巨头进一步掌控 AI 开发者生态与开源基础设施。
items.why_en: Acquiring Hugging Face would let NVIDIA dominate not just AI chips but the developer and open-source ecosystem.

items.title_en: Doubao Phone Launch Date Set: September 16
items.summary_zh: 豆包手机定档9月16日发布 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Doubao phone has been officially scheduled to launch on September 16. No details about specs or pricing have been revealed yet. Given the Doubao brand's AI chatbot association, the device is expected to feature deep AI integration.
items.why_zh: 豆包手机可能将大模型AI能力直接内嵌到消费终端，标志着AI助手赛道正在向硬件延伸。
items.why_en: A Doubao-branded phone would likely bring AI-assistant capabilities directly into consumer hardware, intensifying competition for AI-era device entry points.

items.summary_en: Tongyi Open Platform has released more than 10 financial AI agents spanning securities, insurance and other financial services. The move signals a broader push to apply large language models to specialized industry scenarios. Specific agent names and usage details have yet to be fully disclosed.
items.why_zh: 国内主流大模型平台开始从通用问答走向金融垂直场景的批量供应，对产业AI落地具有示范意义。
items.why_en: It showcases a major LLM platform expanding from general-purpose chat into vertical financial automation, setting an example for AI adoption in regulated industries.

items.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra发布三天，OpenAI首席科学家呼吁紧急暂停开发
items.title_en: GPT-6 Astra Released 3 Days Ago: OpenAI Chief Scientist Calls for Urgent Development Pause
items.summary_zh: 据36氪报道，OpenAI的GPT-6 Astra已于三天前发布。模型刚刚落地，OpenAI首席科学家随即发出呼吁，要求紧急暂停后续开发。报道中未说明呼吁的具体形式与理由，也没有披露是否有更多内部讨论。因此外界暂时难以判断这是策略性警告还是实际叫停。事件发生在新一代大模型交付初期，若暂停属实，将凸显AI行业内部对模型失控风险的警觉。后续OpenAI是否会回应或调整计划，值得持续关注。
items.summary_en: GPT-6 Astra Released 3 Days Ago: OpenAI Chief Scientist Calls for Urgent Development Pause 36 Kr
items.why_zh: 模型刚面世即被内部高管请求叫停，反映出AI研发速度与安全治理之间的尖锐矛盾。
items.why_en: A top OpenAI scientist urging a halt immediately after a major release highlights the growing tension between fast AI progress and safety governance.

items.title_zh: HackProbe：无需权重访问即可检测并免疫自进化语言模型中的奖励黑客
items.title_en: Harness-agnostic detection and immunization of reward hacking in self-evolving language models
items.summary_zh: 自进化语言模型会提出候选更新，并保留那些能提高可见分数的改动。但当分数只是真实能力的近似指标时，持续选择就会拉大二者差距，形成奖励黑客。针对这一风险，论文提出HackProbe，一种可通过两个黑盒钩子接入任意自进化循环的监控器，全程无需读取权重或激活。它内部维护一个秘密且分布固定的比较核心，借助冻结分布让能力代理在不同代际之间可比。该设计旨在提供与具体训练框架无关的检测与免疫手段，为自进化模型增强安全性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04665v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-evolving language models improve by proposing candidate updates and keeping whatever raises a visible score. When that score is an imperfect proxy for the capability one actually wants, sustained selection widens the gap between the two. This is reward hacking. We introduce HackProbe, a monitor that attaches to an arbitrary self-evolving loop through two black-box hooks, with no access to weights or activations. It keeps a secret, distribution-fixed comparison core, whose frozen distribution makes its capability proxy comparable across gener…
items.why_zh: 该研究为自进化AI中的奖励黑客提供了不依赖内部结构的通用监测与免疫方案，对安全推进模型自我改进有关键意义。
items.why_en: By addressing reward hacking without requiring model internals, HackProbe provides a general safeguard for safely scaling self-improving language models.

items.title_zh: FinalityBench：延迟与冲突金融最终性下智能体决策的效果级基准
items.title_en: FinalityBench: An Effect-Level Benchmark for Agent Decisions Under Delayed and Conflicting Financial Finality
items.summary_zh: 论文提出FinalityBench，一个可执行基准，专门评估在延迟和冲突金融最终性下的智能体决策。在真实支付场景中，发给支付处理器、账本、ERP和银行系统的消息可能出现延迟、重复、丢失和乱序，导致同一订单在多个系统中短时间内产生相互矛盾的视图。智能体需要决定发货、重新提交扣款、退款或等待，并清楚其中一些决定无法撤销。FinalityBench会隐藏规范事件日志，并从不同故障投递流中派生各系统的独立视图。由此，研究者可以在效果层面检验智能体面对不一致数据时的决策质量。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04706v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A merchant's payment processor, ledger, ERP and bank feed are updated by messages that get delayed, duplicated, dropped and reordered, so for minutes at a time the four hold contradictory beliefs about the same order. An agent resolving the exception must decide whether to ship goods, re-submit a capture, refund or wait, knowing some of those cannot be undone. We present FinalityBench, an executable benchmark for that decision. It keeps a hidden canonical event log and derives each system's view from a separately faulted delivery stream, so disag…
items.why_zh: 该基准填补了结算不确定条件下智能体决策评估的空白，对构建高可靠金融AI有直接参考价值。
items.why_en: It addresses a missing evaluation layer for AI agents operating under unclear financial finality, helping build trustworthy fintech automation.

items.title_zh: 面向智能体能源采用模型的LLM辅助行为与场景增广方法
items.title_en: LLM-Assisted Behavioural and Scenario Augmentation for Agent-Based Energy Adoption Models
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型的最新进展为基于智能体的能源政策模拟带来了新机会，例如支撑结构化的行为假设与探索性技术经济情景。但论文指出，直接让LLM推理替代现有采用模型，会在可解释性、可复现性和行为有效性等方面引发问题。为解决这一问题，作者提出一种混合框架，将LLM辅助生成的行为规则与场景规格整合进已经校准的智能体能源采用模型中。该方法希望兼顾LLM的灵活性与传统模型的可解释性，为能源政策分析提供一条更稳健的AI辅助路径。该方案的实际效果仍有待实证研究进一步检验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) create opportunities to enrich simulation-based energy policy analysis, particularly by supporting structured behavioural assumptions and exploratory techno-economic scenarios. However, directly replacing adoption models with LLM reasoning raises concerns regarding interpretability, reproducibility, and behavioural validity. This paper proposes a hybrid framework for LLM-assisted specification design, integrating bounded behavioural rubrics and structured scenario specifications into a calibrated ag…
items.why_zh: 它既利用LLM的建模灵活性，又保留传统模拟的可解释性，为AI辅助公共政策分析提供了可落地的路线。
items.why_en: It combines LLM flexibility with traditionally interpretable energy simulations, offering a practical route for AI-assisted public policy analysis.

items.title_zh: AutoLR：自动化工业推荐系统从研究到上线评审之路
items.title_en: AutoLR: Automating the Path from Research to Launch Review in Industrial Recommender Systems
items.summary_zh: 本文以网易游戏社区App DASHEN为背景，指出工业推荐系统改进是一个迭代的研究与工程过程，而非从想法直接到部署。在DASHEN中，算法工程师通常从研究论文、技术报告和过去的线上实验中发现方向，再复现或改编方法，将其实现进生产代码，并通过训练与离线实验评估模型。有潜力的候选方案随后会进入在线A/B测试，经历最终的上线评审。论文提出AutoLR来自动化这一从研究到上线评审的路径，以减少人工琐事、缩短迭代周期。该工作展示了如何把学术界方法与生产系统更高效地连接起来。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04871v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Improving an industrial recommender is an iterative research-and-engineering process rather than a direct path from idea to deployment. In \textbf{DASHEN, NetEase's gaming-community app}, algorithm engineers typically identify promising directions from research papers, technical reports, and prior production experiments; reproduce or adapt the underlying methods; implement them in the production codebase; and evaluate the resulting models through training and offline experiments. Promising candidates are then advanced to online A/B tests, and tho…
items.why_zh: 将该流程自动化能显著降低工业推荐系统中验证和落地新方法的人力成本，直接提升迭代效率。
items.why_en: Automating the research-to-launch pipeline can dramatically speed up iteration and reduce manual overhead in large industrial recommender systems.

items.title_zh: 面向韩国开放公共API的多步工具调用：基准与数据合成方法
items.title_en: Multi-Step Tool-Calling over Korean Open Public APIs: A Benchmark and a Data-Synthesis Recipe
items.summary_zh: 随着数据主权法规的推行，公共机构越来越多地需要部署开源的、本地运行的LLM代理，使其能够跨多个实时政府API链式调用工具。然而，开源模型在这种多步工具调用场景中一直表现欠佳，且此前没有任何基准能够量化这一性能差距。为填补空白，研究者提出了韩国开放公共API基准（KOPA-Bench），包含145个真实世界任务；同时提出EDGE——一种由实时执行驱动、用于工具调用数据合成的动态图方法。EDGE通过实际执行来构建工具交互图并生成训练数据，从而帮助提升开源模型在多步调用上的能力。该研究为在数据敏感场景下评估和优化政府API代理提供了基准和方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data-sovereignty regulations increasingly require public institutions to deploy open-source, on-premise LLM agents that chain multiple tool-calls across live government APIs. However, open-source models consistently underperform in this multi-step setting, and no existing benchmark measures the gap. We introduce the Korean Open Public API Benchmark (KOPA-Bench), comprising 145 real-world tasks. To close this gap, we present EDGE, an Execution-grounded Dynamic Graph for tool-calling data synthEsis driven by live execution. EDGE builds a graph of h…
items.why_zh: 该工作首次为韩国开放公共API的多步工具调用提供基准和高品质数据合成方案，可帮助开源模型满足数据主权合规要求。
items.why_en: It provides the first benchmark and data-synthesis recipe for multi-step tool-calling over Korean open public APIs, enabling open-source models to meet data-sovereignty requirements.

items.title_zh: ARIA：面向信息娱乐系统自主测试的智能体框架
items.title_en: ARIA - An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Testing of Infotainment Systems
items.summary_zh: 汽车信息娱乐系统的验证目前仍依赖手动测试，效率低、成本高，难以适应敏捷开发与OTA更新。脚本化自动化的作用有限，因为它把测试逻辑和实现耦合在一起，导致测试套件脆弱且维护成本高昂。已有的LLM驱动测试框架大多面向网页或移动应用，且常采用单/双智能体结构，把一个或两个模型同时用于感知、规划、动作选择和验证，容易产生幻觉和低效探索循环。本文针对信息娱乐系统的高复杂性，提出了ARIA——一个用于其自主测试的智能体框架，以更合理的多智能体编排来分担这些任务，从而减少幻觉、提升测试稳定性。该工作为汽车软件测试自动化提供了新思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04913v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automotive infotainment validation still relies on manual testing, slow, costly, and incompatible with agile releases and OTA updates. Scripted automation only partly helps: it couples test logic to implementation, yielding brittle, high-maintenance suites. Existing LLM-driven frameworks mostly target web/mobile apps, using single- or dual-agent setups that overload one or two models with perception, planning, action selection, and validation at once, prone to hallucinations and unproductive exploration loops given infotainment complexity. We p…
items.why_zh: 信息娱乐系统测试是汽车软件开发中的瓶颈，ARIA有望以智能体方式实现自动化，降低人工成本并适配敏捷与OTA发布节奏。
items.why_en: Infotainment validation is a key bottleneck in automotive development; ARIA proposes an agentic testing approach to automate and accelerate it.

items.title_zh: 超越共同购买关系：Allegro 互补推荐的演进
items.title_en: Beyond Co-purchase Relation: Evolution of Complementary Recommendations at Allegro
items.summary_zh: 在电商场景中，当顾客把一台专业相机加入购物车后，系统应推荐配套镜头、通用三脚架还是另一台机身？真正有用的互补推荐应推荐能一起使用的商品，但标准的推荐模型常常区分不了“经常被一起购买”和“功能上真正互补”两类关系。为此，论文介绍了在Allegro.com上投入使用的大规模检索框架AlleCompanion。它将包含噪声的行为共现信号转换为精确的语义兼容性，从而更好地支撑互补商品发掘。相关工作代表了从基于共同购买关系向语义兼容匹配演进的推荐思路，对提升购物车完整性和用户体验有直接价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05063v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When a customer adds a professional camera to their cart, should the system suggest a matching lens, a generic tripod, or another camera body? Complementary Product Recommendation is vital for comprehensive basket building, yet standard models often fail to distinguish between items that are merely bought together and those that truly work together. In this paper, we present AlleCompanion: a production-scale retrieval framework deployed at Allegro.com that transforms noisy behavioural signals into precise semantic compatibility. We mitigate the…
items.why_zh: 互补推荐是提升购物车价值和平台营收的关键，AlleCompanion展示了在大规模电商场景中利用语义匹配改进推荐质量的可行路径。
items.why_en: Complementary recommendation is critical for basket building; AlleCompanion shows a production-scale approach to turn noisy co-purchase data into semantic compatibility at Allegro.

items.title_zh: 模式约束的语言模型：在不破坏局部学习稳定性的前提下精炼机器人策略
items.title_en: A Schema Bounded Language Model for Refining Robot Policies Without Destabilizing Local Learning
items.summary_zh: 该文研究在去中心化系统中由异构机器人组成的复合体进行导航的问题，其难点在于策略推理与局部控制运行在不同的更新层级。作者在NetLogo与Python的联合仿真中设置了三台共享运动动力学但使用不同LLM后端的机器人。每台机器人独立结合一个大语言模型策略智能体、一个UCB多臂老虎机和一个Double DQN控制器，没有中央LLM来生成团队层级的动作。LLM的推理被约束在回合级的策略生成与精炼上，这样既可以利用语言模型进行高层修正，又不会破坏局部强化学习的稳定性。这一方法为多机器人系统中安全使用LLM提供了模式约束的设计样例。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05133v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper addresses navigation by composite heterogeneous robots in a decentralized system when policy reasoning and local control operate at different update levels. In a NetLogo--Python implementation, three robots share motion dynamics but use different LLM backends. Each robot independently combines a large language model (LLM) policy agent, an Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) bandit, and a Double Deep Q-Network (Double DQN) controller; no central LLM generates team actions. LLM inference is confined to round-level policy generation and refine…
items.why_zh: 该研究为多机器人系统中引入LLM策略推理提供了“模式约束”思路，在高层调整与底层学习稳定性之间找到平衡。
items.why_en: It offers a schema-bounded way to inject LLM policy refinement into multi-robot systems without disrupting local learning.

items.title_zh: AxQM：有限维量子力学库中教材级形式化证明合成基准
items.title_en: AxQM: A Textbook-Scale Benchmark for Formal Proof Synthesis in a Library of Finite-Dimensional Quantum Mechanics
items.summary_zh: 形式化数学通过证明助手让机器逐条检查定义、陈述和证明，已成为新的严谨性标准。如今大语言模型已经能够自主进行形式化，甚至可以覆盖整本教科书的规模。作者希望把这种机器可验证的严谨性引入物理学，因为物理学中的理论论证常包含很少被完全明确说明的理想化，任何逻辑缺口都可能对相互依赖的结论产生连锁影响。为了评测面向物理学的自动形式化系统，他们发布了AxQM——一个包含1019个经过内核级验证的有限维量子力学命题的定理库。该基准为检验语言模型能否将物理定理与证明翻译为机器可验证形式提供了标尺。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.05157v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Formalizing mathematics in a proof assistant, where a machine checks every definition, statement and proof, has set a new standard of rigor. Large language models are now capable of formalizing autonomously, even at the scale of whole textbooks. We bring this standard of rigor to physics, where theoretical arguments carry idealizations that are rarely stated fully, and any logical gaps could have a cascading effect on interdependent results. Recognizing the need to evaluate autoformalization systems for physics, we release AxQM, 1,019 kernel-ch…
items.why_zh: AxQM将形式化验证的高标准引入物理领域，为衡量和改进大模型在科学理论自动推理中的可靠性提供了关键测试平台。
items.why_en: AxQM brings formal verification standards to physics, providing a key benchmark for evaluating LLM autoformalization in scientific domains.

items.title_zh: 基于梯度的时间序列分类模型捷径检测
items.title_en: Gradient-based Model Shortcut Detection for Time Series Classification
items.summary_zh: 在时间序列分类（TSC）任务中，深度学习模型近年来吸引了大量研究，并已经超越经典的基于距离的方法，取得领先表现。然而，深度神经网络可能依赖训练数据中的虚假相关来做判断，从而限制了其在未知数据上的泛化能力。一个典型例子是：如果训练数据中“猫”的图片总带有草地背景，模型就可能错误地将“草地”当作识别猫的线索。为此，论文提出一种基于梯度的模型捷径检测方法，用于识别模型是否使用了此类非因果的捷径特征。该方法有助于诊断和修正时间序列模型中的欠泛化问题，提高模型在实际应用中的可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2510.10075v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deep learning models have attracted lots of research attention in time series classification (TSC) task in the past two decades. Recently, deep neural networks (DNN) have surpassed classical distance-based methods and achieved state-of-the-art performance. Despite their promising performance, deep neural networks (DNNs) have been shown to rely on spurious correlations present in the training data, which can hinder generalization. For instance, a model might incorrectly associate the presence of grass with the label ``cat" if the trainin…
items.why_zh: 时间序列分类中的捷径学习会严重损害模型的泛化与部署可靠性，基于梯度的检测为识别和缓解虚假相关提供了新工具。
items.why_en: Shortcut learning impairs generalization in TSC models; gradient-based detection offers a way to identify and mitigate such spurious correlations.

items.title_zh: Mitra-v2 技术报告
items.title_en: Mitra-v2 Technical Report
items.summary_zh: Mitra-v2是一个面向表格数据的基础模型，在信用风险评分、临床预测、设备故障检测和房价估算等真实世界分类与回归任务上达到了当前最先进水平。该模型的独特之处在于完全使用合成数据训练，并且其预训练分布比上一代Mitra-v1更大、更多样化。Mitra-v2构建在一个小型2D Transformer骨干之上，支持更长的上下文和更大的特征空间，同时改进的优化方法使它能够从更广阔的任务分布中学习。这一技术报告表明，通过精心设计合成预训练数据的规模和多样性，即使相对紧凑的模型也能成为强大的表格数据基础模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04540v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Mitra-v2, a tabular foundation model that delivers state-of-the-art performance on real-world classification and regression problems, from credit-risk scoring and clinical prediction to equipment-failure detection and house-price estimation. Mitra-v2 is trained only on synthetic data, with a pretraining distribution that is much larger and more diverse than Mitra-v1's. Built on a small 2D Transformer backbone, Mitra-v2 supports longer contexts and larger feature spaces. Improved optimization lets it learn from this larger task distri…
items.why_zh: Mitra-v2证明了仅用合成数据也能训练出强大的通用表格模型，为缺少大规模真实数据表的领域提供了一条高效路径。
items.why_en: Mitra-v2 shows that a tabular foundation model trained only on synthetic data can excel on real-world tasks, offering a data-efficient path for table domains.

items.title_zh: 耦合控制与无线世界模型：实现弹性远程机器人控制
items.title_en: Coupled Control and Wireless World Models for Resilient Remote Robotic Control
items.summary_zh: 在通过无线网络进行远程机器人控制时，系统必须在通信资源有限、信道条件不断变化以及环境扰动存在的情况下维持可靠控制。若持续回传摄像头图像等高维观测数据，将会显著增加通信开销和能量消耗，还会降低在连接不稳定时的整体鲁棒性。针对这一挑战，论文提出了一种具有通信感知能力的弹性远程机器人控制框架，其核心是将机器人控制与无线信道的动态建模进行耦合，即耦合控制与无线世界模型。该方案让控制器能够预判信道状态，在保证任务性能的同时减少不必要的数据传输，并提升对网络变化的适应力。这项研究为无线环境下的远程操控系统设计提供了一条新的技术路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04851v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Remote robotic systems operating over wireless networks must maintain reliable control despite limited communication resources, changing channel conditions, and environmental disturbances.However, continuously transmitting high-dimensional sensory observations, such as camera images, increases communication overhead and energy consumption while reducing robustness under unreliable connectivity.To address these challenges, this paper proposes a resilient communication-aware remote robotic control framework based on coupled control and wireless J…
items.why_zh: 无线网络是远程机器人控制的核心瓶颈，通过联合建模控制与信道，可在节省通信资源的同时提升鲁棒性，对远程医疗、救灾等场景意义重大。
items.why_en: Remote robotic control over wireless demands balancing reliability and limited communications; coupling control with wireless models offers a resilience framework.

items.title_zh: ClosureBench：面向组合图推理的建设性基准
items.title_en: ClosureBench: A Constructive Benchmark for Compositional Graph Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文指出，大语言模型在多步组合推理上表现不佳，但衡量这种失败十分困难，因为新模型往往在用于评估的基准上进行训练。固定测试集在发布后很快会变成对记忆的检验。为避免这一问题，研究者提出构建式基准，按需生成实例。他们推出了ClosureBench，这是一个面向图关系逻辑推理的建设性基准，每个任务由显式原语（如可达性、度数、集合运算、连通性、聚合）构建，参考答案可计算得出。该基准有望更稳定地衡量模型的组合推理能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.18242v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models fail on multi-step compositional reasoning, but measuring that failure is hard, because new models are trained on the benchmarks used to evaluate them. A fixed test set becomes a memorisation check soon after release. Constructive benchmarks avoid this by generating instances on demand. We introduce ClosureBench, a constructive benchmark for graph-relational logical reasoning. Each task is built from explicit primitives (reachability, degree, set operations, connectivity, aggregation), and its reference answer is compute…
items.why_zh: 该基准通过按需生成实例，避免模型在固定测试集上背答案，为评估组合推理能力提供了更可靠的方法。
items.why_en: It offers a more reliable evaluation of compositional reasoning by generating new instances on demand, avoiding benchmark memorization.

items.title_zh: 科大讯飞星火 X2.5 模型正式发布：293B-A30B MoE，全国产平台训练

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 7 日消息，科大讯飞 (iFlytek) 今日正式发布星火 Spark-X2.5 多语言文本生成模型。该模型 基于全国产平台训练 ，采用 MoE 框架，模型参数 293B-A30，支持 256K 上下文。 星火 X2.5 全面提升代码和智能体能力 ，同时覆盖 200 余种语言，在语言理解、答题、推理等通用任务上保持优异的效果。 这款模型目前已在讯飞星辰 MaaS 平台上线，定价如下： 输入：1.6 元人民币 / 百万词元 (Token)； 输入缓存命中：0.24 元人民币 / 百万词元； 输出：6 元人民币 / 百万词元。
items.summary_en: iFlytek officially released the Spark-X2.5 multilingual text generation model on September 7. It is trained entirely on domestic platforms, uses a MoE architecture with 293B-A30 parameters, and supports a 256K context window. The model enhances coding and agent capabilities, covers more than 200 languages, and is now available on the Xunfei Xingchen MaaS platform with pricing of ¥1.6 per million input tokens, ¥0.24 with cache hit, and ¥6 per million output tokens.
items.why_zh: 该模型在国产算力平台上训练并强化代码与Agent能力，体现了国产大模型在千亿级MoE路线上的进展与商业化落地。
items.why_en: It marks progress in domestically trained large MoE models and demonstrates iFlytek's push into code- and agent-focused AI commercialization.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 7 日消息，OPPO 首席产品官、一加创始人刘作虎今日发文预热了 OPPO Find X10 系列手机的相机部分。 他认为，接下来的 10 年真正值得追求的影像是真实自然 。 刘作虎宣布，围绕「真实自然」，OPPO 从 Find X6 系列就开始进行长期的技术积累， 将在 Find X10 系列上推出集大成的全新「哈苏超清原相机」 ： 最强大的 OPPO 哈苏联合研发 2 亿镜头群，不靠“暴力计算”堆清晰，让画质真实细腻，拍出原生好肤质； 最聪明的 LUMO 原生光影引擎，让光影秩序各归其位，逆光人脸也清晰，不再死黑； 最先进的第二代丹霞色彩还原镜头，让肤色真实自然，不让健康的美被相机自作主张地修饰成假白。 刘作虎分享的预热海报也展示了 OPPO Find X10 系列手机的局部一角，可以看到新机采用了横向矩阵阶梯式相机模组，预计边框依旧是小立边设计。 目前， OPPO Find X10 系列目前已有两个机型入网 ，全都支持 N79 5G 频段 +2.4GHz 扩频通信，预装 ColorOS17 AI 系统，备案了多个 AI 大模型。爆料称，系列新机排期 9 月下旬发布，重点关注 2nm 天玑 9600 Pro 处理器，搭载 HPC 2 亿超大底影像，机身正面配备极窄新屏。 据IT之家此前报道， 消息称 OPPO Find X10 Pro Max 手机全球首发三…
items.summary_en: OPPO chief product officer Liu Zuohu says the Find X10 series will introduce a new Hasselblad Ultra-Clear Native Camera focused on natural and realistic images. The system combines a 200MP-class Hasselblad-lens stack, a LUMO natural light engine and second-gen Danxia color reproduction, avoiding heavy computational sharpening. Two Find X10 models have been certified, with a rumored late-September launch featuring MediaTek's 2nm Dimensity 9600 Pro.
items.why_zh: Find X10 系列从“暴力计算”转向“真实自然”，反映出手机影像旗舰开始强调算法与光学协同，而非单纯堆参数。
items.why_en: Find X10 marks a shift from brute-force computational photography to optics- and algorithm-coordinated imaging with a focus on natural output.

items.title_zh: 鸿蒙智行“新锐智慧 SUV”问界 M6 上市累计交付突破 5 万台，售价 22.98 万元起

items.title_zh: 英伟达黄仁勋祝贺 OpenAI 团队发布 Astra，称“AGI 已经到来”
items.title_en: NVIDIA's Jensen Huang Congratulates OpenAI on Astra, Says 'AGI Has Arrived'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 7 日消息，英伟达创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋今天在 X 平台发文，祝贺 OpenAI 发布最新大模型 Astra，并抛出引人注目的观点：AGI 已经到来。 黄仁勋表示：“OpenAI 从发布 ChatGPT 到 o1，再到 Astra 只用了 4 年， AGI 已经到来 ，恭喜 OpenAI 团队。” IT之家注： 通用人工智能（AGI）指的是具备与人类同等智能或超越普通人类的人工智能 ，能表现正常人类所具有的所有智能行为。 OpenAI 本周四正式发布 Astra，官方称其是全球“最智能、最符合人类价值观的模型”，认为该模型能以“无与伦比的速度、准确性和判断力完成最具挑战性的专业工作”。 OpenAI 总裁格雷格 · 布罗克曼随后在一场电话会议中表示：“欢迎来到 AGI 时代。” AI 研究院、批评学者加里 · 马库斯（Gary Marcus）认为，黄仁勋的判断为时过早。他称黄仁勋没有提供任何科学定义，也没有给出任何证据。在他看来，英伟达只是通过单方面宣布，接管原本属于科学范畴的问题。 马库斯同时附上了自己的 10 项 AGI 定义标准，并指出 Astra 目前只能满足其中一到两项。 另一方面，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼最近出席播客节目时认为，AGI 充其量只是定义非常模糊的术语，他甚至表示，AGI 可能只是一个“无关紧要的营销词”。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang congratulated OpenAI on releasing Astra, declaring 'AGI has arrived,' while OpenAI president Greg Brockman said 'Welcome to the AGI era.' However, AI critic Gary Marcus argues this is premature, lacking scientific definition or evidence, and notes Astra meets only one or two of his ten AGI criteria. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has also called AGI a vague, possibly irrelevant marketing term.
items.why_zh: 行业领袖与批评者对“AGI 是否到来”的公开分歧，凸显了 AI 发展里程碑认定的争议及其科学定义缺失问题。
items.why_en: The public clash between an industry leader and critics over whether AGI has arrived highlights the contested nature of AI milestones and the lack of a scientific definition.

items.title_zh: 英伟达确认将投入130亿美元用于Hugging Face AI软件平台

items.summary_en: Nvidia Confirms it Will Spend $13 Billion on Hugging Face AI Software Platform Broadband Breakfast
items.why_zh: 这是芯片巨头对AI开源社区平台的巨额押注，标志着AI竞争从硬件延伸到软件生态。
items.why_en: Nvidia's $13B commitment to Hugging Face signals an escalating battle for AI ecosystem dominance beyond chips.

items.why_en: The launch and Goldman's view link AI technical milestones to market dynamics, highlighting intelligence as the sector's core driver.

items.title_zh: 一周内四家AI实验室相继发布重要模型，买家跟不上
items.title_en: Four AI Labs Released Major Models in One Week and Buyers Can't Keep Up
items.summary_zh: 据Startup Fortune报道，四家人工智能实验室在一周之内接连发布了重量级模型，密集的发布节奏让下游客户应接不暇。买家在模型选型、成本评估和业务集成方面面临更大压力，因为模型版本更替过快可能导致刚部署的方案很快过时。报道认为，这种局面反映了AI产业竞争不断升级，实验室之间的发布竞赛正在重塑采购决策周期。不过，报道没有具体披露这四家实验室的名称或模型的能力细节。对于企业和开发者来说，如何跟上这一波技术浪潮并有效利用新模型，正成为新的课题。
items.summary_en: Four AI Labs Released Major Models in One Week and Buyers Can't Keep Up Startup Fortune
items.why_zh: 模型发布过于密集意味着技术迭代周期缩短，企业的AI投资策略必须随之调整，这是产业进入新阶段的信号。
items.why_en: The compressed release timeline signals a new level of AI competition, compelling enterprises to adapt procurement strategies.

items.title_zh: Metrisque推出首个AI可见性衡量方法，标榜结果一致性
items.title_en: Metrisque Launches the First Way to Measure AI Visibility That Gives the Same Answer
items.summary_zh: 据The National Law Review报道，Metrisque推出了首创的AI可见性衡量方法，其特点是能够提供一致的答案。在AI生成内容日益重要的当下，企业越来越需要了解自身在AI推荐和回答中的曝光度。Metrisque宣称，这一方法有助于统一不同评估场景下的衡量标准，为品牌和机构提供一个共同参考。目前该公司尚未公开详细的技术原理，实际效果仍有待市场检验。
items.summary_en: Metrisque Launches the First Way to Measure AI Visibility That Gives the Same Answer The National Law Review
items.why_zh: 它为评估品牌在AI生态中的可见度提供了新的统一工具，是AI营销和品牌管理的基础设施。
items.why_en: It provides a standardized way to measure brand presence in an AI-driven discovery landscape, which is becoming essential for digital reputation.

items.title_zh: 夏威夷大学推出免费AI课程，提升全州AI素养
items.title_en: UH launches free AI course aimed at building literacy across Hawaii
items.summary_zh: 夏威夷大学（UH）本周宣布推出一门面向全州的人工智能普及课程，不向学员收取任何费用。课程的主要目标是帮助夏威夷居民建立对AI技术的基本认识和实际运用能力，缩小不同社区之间的数字鸿沟。对于当地学生、职场人士和普通居民而言，这门课程提供了一条低成本了解AI的路径。由于课程处于刚启动阶段，官方尚未公布课程大纲和报名方式。这一举措也反映出美国高校正在积极参与公共AI教育。
items.summary_en: UH launches free AI course aimed at building literacy across Hawaii Honolulu Star-Advertiser
items.why_zh: 免费覆盖全州的AI课程有助于缩小数字鸿沟，让AI知识不再局限于少数人群。
items.why_en: By offering free AI education statewide, the University of Hawaii is helping close the AI literacy gap for a broad population.

items.title_zh: 小米卢伟冰预告明晚发布会有惊喜，雷军讲全场
items.title_en: Xiaomi's Sept. 7 Event: Lei Jun to Host, Pengcheng N70/N90 and 18 Fold to Debut
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 6 日消息，小米集团合伙人、总裁卢伟冰今晚发文称：“彩排结束，内容很丰富， 还有惊喜 。”此外，他还在评论区透露本次发布会不会登场， 雷军将讲全场 。 IT之家注意到，小米秋季旗舰新品发布会将于 9 月 7 日晚 7 点举行，小米澎程 N70 Pro、N70 Max、N90 Max 正式上市。同场发布的，还有两款旗舰新品：小米 18 Fold 全新折叠屏旗舰手机、小米平板 9 Pro Max，首发玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰处理器。 雷军此前透露，这次的发布会是小米科技创新的一次集中展示，时间估计有点长，会努力控制在 2 小时 45 分钟 以内。 主要产品中，今年 7 月 30 日，小米举行了澎程技术发布会，澎程 N90 Max 预售价为 29.99 万元；澎程 N70 Max 预售价为 25.99 万元。 小米 18 Fold 搭载 5.38 英寸外屏 + 7.58 英寸内屏，首发搭载玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰 SoC，配备徕卡 2 亿超清主摄（1/1.56″大底传感器）+ 徕卡 5000 万潜望长焦（3.5 倍光学变焦）+ 徕卡 5000 万超广角，内置 6000mAh 小米金沙江电池，支持 67W 有线秒充 + 50W 无线秒充。 小米平板 9 Pro Max 号称“小米最强专业生产力平板”，首发玄戒 O3 AI 旗舰处理器，搭载了一块 13.3 英寸高清原色屏，3.…
items.summary_en: Xiaomi will hold its autumn flagship launch on September 7 at 7pm, unveiling the Pengcheng N70 Pro, N70 Max, and N90 Max, alongside the Mi 18 Fold foldable and Pad 9 Pro Max tablet. Xiaomi president Lu Weibing said there will be surprises and that Lei Jun will host the entire event. The 18 Fold features the Xuanjie O3 AI SoC, Leica triple cameras, and a 6000mAh battery with 67W wired and 50W wireless charging.
items.why_zh: 这场发布会同时覆盖澎程、折叠屏和AI平板，是观察小米多领域AI与硬件协同的重要窗口。
items.why_en: This event combines Xiaomi's Pengcheng product line, foldable flagship, and AI tablet in one showcase, making it a key indicator of Xiaomi's multi-category innovation.

items.title_zh: AI 短剧爆发带火“人脸授权”，普通人数字肖像价格约每部 100 元
items.title_en: AI Short Dramas Fuel Face Authorization: Ordinary People Earn ~100 Yuan per Video
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 6 日消息，据央视财经报道，随着 AI 短剧、数字广告产业快速扩张， 数字人脸素材采购需求持续高涨 。 一门特殊的生意 ——“人脸授权”也因此火了起来。不用出镜拍戏、无需线下试镜， 依靠自己的面部形象就能赚取收益 。 IT之家从报道获悉，平台工作人员表示，根据授权人不同，AI 数字形象分为普通人和专业演员两大类： 普通人的数字肖像按照每部短视频约 100 元付费使用； 专业演员则按使用范围和剧集长度定价，价格从 500 元到数千元。 采购方可以按年龄、性别、风格挑选并购买使用权。成交后，平台和授权人按比例分成。 行业研究机构 Data Eye 的估算数据显示，今年前 5 个月，AI 短剧市场规模已突破 220 亿元，全年有望冲击 400 亿元大关；一季度全行业上线的微短剧中，AI 微短剧占比超过 95%。
items.summary_en: The rise of AI-generated short dramas has boosted demand for digital face assets, with platforms offering paid authorization from ordinary people (about 100 yuan per video) and actors (500 to several thousand yuan). According to Data Eye, the AI short-drama market surpassed 22 billion yuan in the first five months of the year and may reach 40 billion yuan annually.
items.why_zh: 它展现了AI内容产业的新商业模式，普通人也能通过授权数字肖像获利，并印证AI短剧市场的爆发式增长备受资本关注。
items.why_en: It highlights a new AI-content business model where anyone can monetize their likeness, signaling the explosive growth of AI-driven short-drama entertainment.

items.title_zh: 科技巨头密集更新 AI 模型，“模型疲劳”问题凸显
items.title_en: AI Giants Roll Out Models in Rapid Succession, Sparking 'Model Fatigue'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 6 日消息，据 CNBC 报道，本周，人工智能行业再次迎来一轮密集更新。首先是 Anthropic 更新了 Fable 和 Mythos 模型，随后 Meta 和谷歌相继推出模型升级，OpenAI 紧接着发布了 GPT-6 Astra。 短短一周内，多家争夺人工智能技术领先地位的公司接连推出更新和升级，节奏之快令人眼花缭乱。 OpenAI CEO 萨姆 · 奥尔特曼当地时间周四在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“我们都在加快迭代节奏。”他认为，近期更新速度加快的部分原因，是“大家都结束暑假回来了”。 但对于 AI 模型和服务的用户而言，这种快速迭代也带来了复杂性和混乱。为了避免掉队，企业 CEO 和 IT 管理人员不得不投入大量时间和资源，对不同产品的价格和能力进行比较。 AI 初创公司 Runpod CEO Zhen Lu 表示：“我觉得‘模型疲劳’确实已经成为一个真实存在的问题。不要误会，我对目前发生的各种创新感到非常兴奋，但我确实认为，我们现在所处的环境有太多泡沫，企业不得不不断制造声量。” 圣母大学门多萨商学院教授、拥有 25 年 AI 从业经验的 Ahmed Abbasi 表示，各家模型开发商如今都在争夺用户预算份额，它们一边努力跟上竞争对手的节奏，一边不断提醒开发者，自己至少与其他公司一样快地推进创新。 尤其是 Anthropic 和 OpenAI，两家公…
items.summary_en: This week saw a burst of AI model releases: Anthropic updated its Fable and Mythos models, Meta and Google followed, and OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said the industry is accelerating its iteration pace, partly because everyone is back from summer break. The rapid churn has created “model fatigue,” warned Runpod CEO Zhen Lu, as enterprises struggle to evaluate an overwhelming number of options.
items.why_zh: 模型发布速度的竞赛既体现创新活力，也增加企业选择成本和市场噪音，正在影响AI行业的应用落地节奏。
items.why_en: The rapid-fire release of AI models makes innovation speed both a competitive weapon and a source of fatigue, challenging enterprise adoption decisions.

items.title_zh: 豪掷25.6亿美元，DeepSeek大量采购华为芯片？
items.title_en: DeepSeek Reportedly Spends $2.56B on Huawei Chips, Claim Still Unverified
items.summary_zh: 豪掷25.6亿美元，DeepSeek大量采购华为芯片？ 风闻
items.summary_en: An unconfirmed report on the Fengwen platform claims DeepSeek is spending $2.56 billion on Huawei chips. Neither DeepSeek nor Huawei has commented. The lack of official details suggests the news should be treated with caution.
items.why_zh: 若消息属实，这笔订单将是中国AI公司大额采购国产芯片的标志性事件，并将影响AI芯片产业预期；但目前证据不足，需谨慎看待。
items.why_en: A confirmed deal would mark a milestone in China's push for domestic AI chips, but until verified it remains a major speculation with significant implications.

items.title_zh: Kraken上线OpenAI和Anthropic的Pre-IPO永续合约
items.title_en: Kraken launches OpenAI and Anthropic pre-IPO perps
items.summary_zh: 加密货币交易所Kraken宣布上线针对OpenAI和Anthropic的Pre-IPO永续合约。这类产品是无需到期日的加密衍生品，允许交易者在两家AI公司尚未上市时，对其估值走势进行做多或做空。Kraken希望借此吸引希望参与AI头部公司股权价格博弈的投资者，并为他们提供新的风险对冲方式。由于OpenAI和Anthropic均未公开上市，合约价格可能更多反映市场对两家公司未来价值的预期。该举动也被视为加密衍生品市场向AI一级市场延伸的又一尝试。
items.summary_en: Kraken launches OpenAI and Anthropic pre-IPO perps Crypto News
items.why_zh: 它将加密衍生品交易带入未上市的AI赛道，为投资者提供了押注OpenAI和Anthropic估值的渠道，也凸显AI资产正进入另类金融市场。
items.why_en: This launch opens crypto-style speculation to private AI giants, signaling a new way to trade equity exposure in top AI firms.

items.title_zh: 字节再次上调“豆包股”价格；国家人工智能基金14亿元入股可灵AI｜一周未来商业
items.title_en: ByteDance Raises 'Doubao Stock' Price Again; National AI Fund Puts RMB 1.4B into Kling AI
items.summary_zh: 字节再次上调“豆包股”价格；国家人工智能基金14亿元入股可灵AI｜一周未来商业 mrjjxw.com
items.summary_en: ByteDance has raised the price of its 'Doubao shares' again, according to a weekly business brief. In addition, China's National AI Fund invested RMB 1.4 billion in Kling AI, a video-generation AI developer. The moves signal accelerating capital flows into AI-related ventures.
items.why_zh: 这集中体现了商业与国家级资本对AI领域的持续加码，也反映字节跳动AI相关估值正在上修，AI赛道热度仍在升温。
items.why_en: The two updates show continued investor appetite for AI firms and ongoing valuation adjustments at ByteDance, highlighting AI as a strategic investment focus.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 应用研究主管谈空间推理，称 Astra 模型已补上人类少数优势
items.title_en: OpenAI Executive Says Astra Model Closes Spatial Reasoning Gap, Erasing a Last Human Advantage
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 6 日消息，OpenAI 应用研究主管鲍里斯 · 鲍尔（Boris Power）今天在 X 平台表示， 空间推理曾是人类大幅领先计算机的少数优势之一 ，如今有了 Astra 模型，这一差距已不复存在。 据悉，独立 AI 研究员 @spicylemonade 曾在今天早些时候表示，Astra 在他的空间推理评估中表现堪称完美，完全“吃透”了所有题目。他认为大语言模型（LLM）的视觉能力问题已经彻底解决，而在过去，所有 LLM 在他的题目中总是出错。 据IT之家了解，GPT-6 Astra 距离 GPT-5 模型系列推出约一年，距离 OpenAI 最近一次推出 GPT-5.6 升级约两个月。 OpenAI 称 Astra 是“全球最智能、对齐程度最高的模型” ，并将其形容为专业工作的一次跃迁。 根据介绍，Astra 可以填写表格、调整文档格式、安排预约以及操作软件。“任何你能在电脑上完成的事情，Astra 都能替你完成，而且速度很快。”OpenAI 总裁布罗克曼更是自信放话：“欢迎来到 AGI 时代”。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's app research lead Boris Power said the Astra model has closed the spatial-reasoning gap that was once one of the last areas where humans clearly beat computers. A researcher's evaluation showed Astra aced all spatial tasks, marking a turning point for LLM vision. OpenAI calls Astra its smartest, best-aligned model and a leap for professional work, with its president declaring 'Welcome to the AGI era.'
items.why_zh: 攻克空间推理意味着AI连人类的传统认知优势也逐步追平，AGI的到来或比预期更近。
items.why_en: By conquering spatial reasoning, AI has erased another human cognitive advantage, making AGI seem within reach.

items.title_en: Weekly AI Roundup: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Astra, National Fund Pours 1.4B Yuan into Kling, Alibaba Launches Qwen3.8-Max

It tracks fast model iteration, state-backed AI investment, and intensifying competition among Chinese tech giants.
items.why_zh: 该周报浓缩了本周AI最具代表性的技术创新、资本注入与巨头迭代线索，便于快速把握行业风向。
items.why_en: The roundup condenses the week's key AI signals—new models, state funding, and tech-giant upgrades—into a quick sector overview.

items.title_zh: 先来一版：华为 Mate 80 系列手机率先开更 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.105 SP10 版本
items.title_en: Huawei Mate 80 Series Gets First HarmonyOS 7.0.0.105 SP10 Update
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 7 日消息，在 HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2 及全场景新品发布会进行之初，华为 Mate 80 系列手机率先开更 HarmonyOS 7.0.0.105 SP10 版本。 ▲ IT之家开箱：华为 Mate 80 Pro Max 风驰版图赏 新版本大小约 4.83GB。据介绍，本次更新将带来更便捷的全场景互联、更智能的系统智能体小艺、更流畅的使用体验。IT之家附完整更新日志如下： HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2 及全场景新品发布会正在进行中，IT之家稍后将带来华为鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7 正式版的最新消息。
items.summary_en: As the HarmonyOS 7 launch event began, Huawei started rolling out the HarmonyOS 7.0.0.105 SP10 update to Mate 80 series phones. The package is about 4.83GB and promises easier cross-device connectivity, a smarter Xiaoyi assistant, and smoother performance. The update serves as a preview before the official HarmonyOS 7 release.
items.why_zh: 这一更新抢先覆盖旗舰机型，预示着华为新一代系统正式版即将全面升级生态体验。
items.why_en: The early rollout to flagship phones signals Huawei's upcoming HarmonyOS 7 official release is imminent, with enhanced AI and connectivity.

items.title_zh: 杰富瑞：将智谱目标价由1299.8港元降至1183.79港元，维持持有评级。
items.title_en: Jefferies Cuts Zhipu Target Price to HK$1183.79, Maintains Hold Rating
items.summary_zh: 杰富瑞：将智谱目标价由1299.8港元降至1183.79港元，维持持有评级。 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Jefferies lowered its target price for Zhipu from HK$1299.8 to HK$1183.79 and maintained a Hold rating. The adjustment suggests a more cautious near-term view on the stock, while the overall rating remains unchanged. Zhipu, an AI company, continues to attract investor attention amid valuation shifts.
items.why_zh: 智谱目标价被下调但维持持有，反映机构对AI企业估值的最新判断，影响市场信心。
items.why_en: The target price cut with a Hold rating signals changing institutional expectations for an AI firm's valuation.

items.title_zh: 四大AI预测卡尔马vs尤尔加登：各家一致看好客队取胜
items.title_en: Four AI Models Predict Kalmar vs Djurgården: All Favor Away Win
items.summary_zh: 四大AI预测卡尔马vs尤尔加登：各家一致看好客队取胜 懂球帝
items.summary_en: Four AI models unanimously predict that Djurgården will beat Kalmar in their upcoming match, according to Dongqiudi. The forecasts likely rely on team statistics and recent form, though no detailed methodology was given. AI-based sports predictions are becoming more common, but outcomes remain uncertain.
items.why_zh: 展示AI在体育预测中的应用，并反映模型对赛事的一致判断。
items.why_en: Highlights AI's growing use in sports prediction and consensus among models.

items.title_zh: 豆包手机将批量上市 样机曾引发巨大争议
items.title_en: Doubao Phones to Hit Market in Volume After Prototype Controversy
items.summary_zh: 豆包手机将批量上市 样机曾引发巨大争议 联合早报
items.summary_en: The "Doubao phone" is set to go into mass production, according to Lianhe Zaobao, after its prototype sparked significant controversy. Details of the controversy and launch date have not been disclosed. The move highlights growing interest in AI-enabled consumer hardware.
items.why_zh: AI品牌牵手手机硬件，样机争议后批量上市反映AI终端商业化加速。
items.why_en: Bringing an AI assistant brand into smartphones marks a step toward AI-native device commercialization.

items.title_zh: 四大AI预测马尔默vsAIK索尔纳：两家猜主胜，两家看好平局
items.title_en: Four AI Models Split on Malmö vs AIK: Two Predict Home Win, Two Draw
items.summary_zh: 四大AI预测马尔默vsAIK索尔纳：两家猜主胜，两家看好平局 懂球帝
items.summary_en: Four AI models offered split predictions for the Malmö vs AIK match, with two choosing a home win and two a draw, according to Dongqiudi. This shows that AI forecasts are less reliable when teams are closely matched. Actual match outcomes remain unpredictable.
items.why_zh: AI模型在同一场次预测出现分歧，提醒用户理性看待AI体育预测。
items.why_en: Divergent AI predictions underscore the limits of AI in forecasting evenly matched contests.

items.title_zh: Anthropic的IPO规模巨大但风险重重：投资者需警惕这些挑战
items.title_en: Anthropic’s IPO Will Be Huge—and Risky. Here Are the Challenges Investors Should Watch
items.summary_zh: Morningstar发布评论称，人工智能公司Anthropic即将进行的首次公开募股（IPO）预计规模巨大，但风险同样不可小觑。评论提醒投资者在参与IPO前，应重点审视其中存在的多重挑战，例如高估值能否持续、市场环境变化以及公司自身的长期竞争力等。文章强调，尽管IPO可能吸引大量关注，但投资者需保持理性，避免被市场热情裹挟。Anthropic作为AI领域的重要企业，其上市定价与后市表现将对整个AI行业估值带来风向标意义。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s IPO Will Be Huge—and Risky. Here Are the Challenges Investors Should Watch Morningstar
items.why_zh: Anthropic上市被视为AI资本热度风向标，但文章提示风险，有助于投资者理性评估。
items.why_en: It signals that a top AI company’s IPO comes with both hype and serious risks, shaping investor sentiment.

items.title_zh: 16万颗华为芯落地！DeepSeek绕开封锁：一场“绕过卡脖的长征”开始了！
items.title_en: DeepSeek Deploys 160,000 Huawei Chips, Eyeing End-Run Around Restrictions
items.summary_zh: 16万颗华为芯落地！DeepSeek绕开封锁：一场“绕过卡脖的长征”开始了！ Sohu
items.summary_en: A Sohu report says DeepSeek has deployed 160,000 Huawei chips, marking a move to work around external technology restrictions. The story compares the effort to a "Long March" to bypass bottlenecks, though no further technical details were provided. The deployment shows growing reliance on domestic chips in China's AI race.
items.why_zh: 大规模采用国产芯片意味着中国AI算力对外部技术的依赖开始出现结构性变化。
items.why_en: Major adoption of domestic chips signals a shift toward self-reliance in China's AI computing capacity.

items.title_zh: PUCPR与404创新工作室发起“永不停思”活动，力推保护人类思维的免费协议Humanitas Code
items.title_en: PUCPR and 404 Innovation Studio Launch ‘Never Stop Thinking’ Campaign Supporting Humanitas Code — a Free Protocol Built to Protect Human Thinking in the Age of AI
items.summary_zh: 据报道，PUCPR与404创新工作室联合发起名为“永不停思”（Never Stop Thinking）的宣传活动，支持一个名为Humanitas Code的免费协议。该协议旨在AI时代保护人类的独立思考与决策能力，避免人的思维被算法或技术主导。活动倡导在人工智能日益普及的环境中，依然要重视人的主体地位。目前关于协议的具体技术内容与参与方式尚未详细披露。这一举措反映了教育界与创新界对AI伦理话题的持续关注。
items.summary_en: PUCPR and 404 Innovation Studio Launch ‘Never Stop Thinking’ Campaign Supporting Humanitas Code — a Free Protocol Built to Protect Human Thinking in the Age of AI CustomerThink
items.why_zh: 这是教育与创新机构围绕AI时代“人类思维保护”推出的免费协议倡议，凸显AI伦理新议题。
items.why_en: It showcases a novel initiative aimed at safeguarding human thought from AI-driven influence, a rising concern in AI ethics.

items.title_zh: 快讯｜“豆包手机”将于9月16日上市
items.title_en: Breaking: Doubao Phone Set for Release on September 16
items.summary_zh: 快讯｜“豆包手机”将于9月16日上市 Sohu
items.summary_en: The "Doubao phone" will be released on September 16, according to a Sohu bulletin. Specific details such as specs, pricing, and sales channels have not been announced yet. The announcement builds anticipation for the AI-branded device.
items.why_zh: 上市日期确定意味着豆包AI生态正式向硬件终端延伸。
items.why_en: A confirmed launch date marks a concrete step for AI-branded consumer hardware.

items.title_zh: “豆包手机”9月16日上市
items.title_en: Doubao Phone to Launch on September 16
items.summary_zh: “豆包手机”9月16日上市 新浪财经
items.summary_en: As reported by Sina Finance, the 'Doubao Phone' will officially go on sale on September 16. The news has drawn attention, although key details such as specifications, price, and sales channels have not been released.
items.why_zh: “豆包手机”的上市计划将AI应用与消费硬件结合推向新看点，值得关注其能否在手机市场开辟差异化路径。
items.why_en: The launch plan of the 'Doubao Phone' highlights the growing integration of AI apps with consumer hardware and could signal a new market trend.

items.title_zh: 最新特别报道｜“Kimi时刻”来临
items.title_en: Caixin Special Report: The 'Kimi Moment' Has Arrived
items.summary_zh: 最新特别报道｜“Kimi时刻”来临 财新周刊
items.summary_en: Caixin Weekly's latest special report is titled 'The Kimi Moment Has Arrived.' The report signals that the AI technology or product Kimi is reaching a pivotal point, though specifics remain to be seen. It reflects rising attention to Kimi's role in the evolving AI landscape.
items.why_zh: “Kimi时刻”的提法可能标志着AI应用竞争进入新节点，对观察行业风向具有重要参考价值。
items.why_en: The notion of a 'Kimi moment' indicates a potential turning point in AI, providing a key signal for industry watchers.

items.title_zh: 黄仁勋：GPT-6 Astra发布后AGI已到来
items.title_en: Jensen Huang says "AGI has arrived" following OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra launch (NVDA:NASDAQ)
items.summary_zh: 据Seeking Alpha报道，在OpenAI推出GPT-6 Astra之后，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋公开表示“AGI已经到来”。作为全球AI算力基础设施的核心人物，黄仁勋的这番表态被视为对新一代大模型能力的有力背书，也令市场对GPT-6 Astra的期待进一步升温。报道同时挂出英伟达在纳斯达克的股票代码NVDA，暗示这一言论可能与英伟达的AI业务前景相关。不过，关于AGI的定义和实现程度，业界依然存在不小争议。此次表态或许会引发关于通用人工智能成熟度的新一轮讨论。
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang says "AGI has arrived" following OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra launch (NVDA:NASDAQ) Seeking Alpha
items.why_zh: 黄仁勋作为AI基础设施领军者高调宣称“AGI已来”，可能重新定义市场对AI技术阶段的认知并影响投资情绪。
items.why_en: Jensen Huang's high-profile claim that AGI has arrived could reshape market perceptions of AI progress and influence investment sentiment.

items.title_zh: MiniMax M3获沙特本地“公民身份”，中国开源模型拿下国家级关键客户
items.title_en: MiniMax M3 "gains Saudi local 'citizenship' status", China's open-source model has secured a "national-level key client"
items.summary_zh: 据相关报道，中国AI企业MiniMax的开源模型M3在沙特阿拉伯获得了“本地公民身份”待遇，标志着该模型在本地合规及认可方面取得突破。与此同时，M3还成功签约了一个“国家级关键客户”，表明其技术能力与商业服务已获得沙特市场更高级别的认可。这一进展不仅有助于MiniMax拓展中东地区业务，也为中国开源模型出海提供了正面案例。目前，关于该客户的具体背景及合作规模尚未进一步披露。
items.summary_en: MiniMax M3 "gains Saudi local 'citizenship' status", China's open-source model has secured a "national-level key client" 36 Kr
items.why_zh: 中国开源模型首获沙特本地身份并切入国家级客户，显示国产AI出海深度正在提高。
items.why_en: This shows Chinese open-source models are gaining trust and reaching deeper into foreign markets.

items.title_zh: Dimenso融资60万欧元，打造实验室AI操作系统
items.title_en: Dimenso Raises €600,000 from Draper B1 and Next Tier Ventures to Drive the AI-Powered Operating System Transforming Laboratories - Capital-Riesgo.es
items.summary_zh: 据Capital-Riesgo.es报道，Dimenso公司已从Draper B1和Next Tier Ventures两家机构获得60万欧元投资。该公司正在打造一套AI驱动的操作系统，核心目标是利用人工智能技术改造传统实验室的运作方式，使其更加智能化与高效化。本次投资金额虽属早期规模，但由专注前沿科技的风险基金参与，显示出对AI在科研领域落地潜力的认可。融资所得将用于推进该系统开发，帮助产品走向更广泛的应用场景。
items.summary_en: Dimenso Raises €600,000 from Draper B1 and Next Tier Ventures to Drive the AI-Powered Operating System Transforming Laboratories - Capital-Riesgo.es Capital Riesgo
items.why_zh: 该融资显示资本正积极押注AI赋能实验室科研的垂直机会，可能带动实验室数字化基础设施的投资热潮。
items.why_en: The investment highlights growing investor interest in AI-powered laboratory innovation and could spur further funding in research infrastructure.

items.title_zh: “豆包手机二代”9月16日上市：搭载豆包手机助手，从预览版走向量产
items.title_en: Doubao Phone 2nd Gen launches Sept 16 with Doubao Assistant, moving from preview to mass production
items.summary_zh: “豆包手机二代”9月16日上市：搭载豆包手机助手，从预览版走向量产 新浪财经
items.summary_en: The second-generation Doubao Phone goes on sale September 16, featuring the Doubao assistant, marking a transition from preview to official mass production. It represents a key step in embedding large-model capabilities into consumer smartphones.
items.why_zh: AI助手从预览到量产，豆包手机二代是大模型终端落地的重要风向标。
items.why_en: This launch marks a milestone for putting large-model assistants into mass-market phones.

items.title_zh: 烧钱、竞速、斩杀线，从智谱半年报看大模型赛道的下半场
items.title_en: Mind-boggling cash burn, racing to scale, and a kill line: what Zhipu's H1 report says about the AI model race's second half
items.summary_zh: 烧钱、竞速、斩杀线，从智谱半年报看大模型赛道的下半场 Sohu
items.summary_en: Zhipu's H1 figures reveal RMB 2 billion in losses, underscoring brutal capital burn in China's large-model race. With funding tightening, firms face an "elimination line" unless they can monetize quickly. Zhipu's token-sales push reflects the urgent search for viable business models.
items.why_zh: 智谱半年报折射出大模型行业从拼技术转向拼商业化的洗牌阶段。
items.why_en: Zhipu's report captures the transition from technology showcase to monetization bloodbath in China's AI industry.

items.title_zh: Nscale与Figure签署35亿美元AI计算协议
items.title_en: Nscale and Figure sign US$ 3.5 billion AI compute deal
items.summary_zh: 据报道，AI基础设施服务商Nscale与机器人公司Figure已签署一项总价值35亿美元的AI计算合作协议。该协议旨在为Figure提供大规模、可持续的算力资源，以满足其在人工智能模型训练与产品开发中的算力需求。这笔交易的金额相当可观，反映出机器人技术进一步与AI结合时，对高性能计算的需求呈爆发式增长。同时，这也标志着AI算力正成为类似基础设施建设的重要资源，推动产业链上下游企业形成长期深度绑定。目前双方尚未公布具体的服务方案与交付时间线。
items.summary_en: Nscale and Figure sign US$ 3.5 billion AI compute deal W.Media
items.why_zh: 35亿美元算力订单凸显机器人+大模型对算力的巨大需求，算力已成为产业关键资源。
items.why_en: The $3.5B deal underscores the strategic importance of compute in AI-powered robotics.

items.title_zh: 英伟达成为AI行业的“中央银行”
items.title_en: NVIDIA Emerges as AI Industry's Central Bank
items.summary_zh: 有评论文章指出，英伟达正在成为人工智能行业的“中央银行”。作为一种比喻，这反映了英伟达GPU在大模型训练和推理中的核心地位。几乎所有主要AI系统都依赖其计算芯片，使英伟达掌握着类似“货币发行”的算力资源配置能力。这种角色不仅让英伟达拥有极大的定价权和产业影响力，也引发外界对算力过度集中的担忧。该现象正促使全球科技公司与政府反思如何在关键AI基础设施上降低对单一供应商的依赖。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA Emerges as AI Industry's Central Bank 조선일보
items.why_zh: 英伟达的央行级地位揭示了算力分配机制对AI创新格局的巨大影响。
items.why_en: Its central-bank-like role illuminates how compute distribution shapes AI progress.

items.summary_en: The "Doubao Phone Gen 2" is set to launch on September 16. No detailed specs have been made public. The naming suggests close backing from ByteDance's Doubao AI ecosystem, making this a test of consumer appetite for AI-powered devices.
items.why_zh: 该产品上市将检验AI手机能否成为大众级趋势，影响后续终端AI布局。
items.why_en: It signals the rapid push to turn AI assistants into consumer hardware.

items.title_zh: 从匹配模型到招聘代理：AI招聘系统、评估与治理的系统化叙事综述
items.title_en: From Matching Models to Recruiting Agents: A Systematized Narrative Review of AI Recruitment Systems, Evaluation, and Governance
items.summary_zh: 本文系统化梳理了AI在招聘领域的演进：自动化对象已从简单的简历匹配与排名，转向多阶段工作流——能够检索证据、比较候选人、支持甚至执行招聘决策。综述沿双边检索、行为排名，延伸到神经人职匹配、大语言模型（LLM）组件以及调用工具的招聘代理。作者采用了截至2026年7月23日的定向检索与编码方案，并于2026年9月2日做了相应更新。全文侧重评估当前AI招聘系统的能力与治理框架，为该领域的技术进程与监管思考提供了全景式参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04286v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence in recruitment has shifted the object being automated from profile pairs and ranked lists to multi-stage workflows that retrieve evidence, compare candidates, and support or execute actions. This systematized narrative review traces that development from bilateral retrieval and behavioral ranking through neural person--job matching, large language model (LLM) components, and tool-using recruiting agents. Using a purposive search and coding protocol updated through 23 July 2026, plus targeted updates through 2 September 202…
items.why_zh: 它为理解和治理AI招聘技术提供了一份系统的演化地图，尤其点明招聘自动化已进入代理化阶段。
items.why_en: It offers a comprehensive roadmap of AI recruitment's shift toward agentic automation and highlights the need for updated evaluation and governance.

items.title_zh: Harbor Adapters与Harbor-Index：大规模智能体评估的基础设施与精选元数据集
items.title_en: Harbor Adapters and Harbor-Index: Infrastructure and a Curated Meta-Dataset for Large-Scale Agentic Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 面对日益增多的智能体基准测试，不同环境与接口使评估工作难以直接展开。本文发布了Harbor Adapters，一个统一的智能体评估基础设施，可将80多个基准测试进行适配，便于任意智能体接入，并通过严格的代码审查与并行实验验证适配器可靠性。基于该设施，作者对涵盖不同能力档次的8个模型在54个基准上做了大规模评估，并制作了精选元数据集Harbor-Index。这项工作旨在为智能体系统的大规模横向比较提供可复现、低门槛的公共基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evaluating agents on the growing number of agentic benchmarks is challenging because they often require complex environments and agent integrations. We introduce Harbor Adapters, a unified evaluation infrastructure for agentic benchmarks. Our work makes three contributions. First, we develop benchmark adapters that port more than 80 benchmarks to evaluate arbitrary agents, and validate them through rigorous code review and parity experiments. Second, we conduct a large-scale evaluation of 8 models spanning capability tiers across 54 benchmarks; e…
items.why_zh: 它为智能体评估提供了统一、可扩展的基础设施与数据资产，能大幅降低新基准、新模型的评测门槛。
items.why_en: It lowers the barrier to rigorous agent evaluation by providing a reusable infrastructure and a curated dataset across many benchmarks.

items.title_zh: 企业语言模型（CLM）：将隐性、碎片化企业知识转化为自主可控、可审计、可执行的企业智能层
items.title_en: Corporate Language Model (CLM): Transforming Tacit and Fragmented Enterprise Knowledge into a Sovereign, Auditable, and Executable Corporate Intelligence Layer
items.summary_zh: 论文认为，企业AI落地失败往往不是模型本身能力不足，而是缺乏一套能表达企业决策、谈判与执行逻辑的结构化底座。通用大模型没有公司专属的本体先验，RAG（检索增强生成）脆弱且无法产出可执行动作，静态流程剧本又无法推理和自适应。为此，作者提出企业语言模型（CLM），要求把隐性知识捕获、本体锚定、主权部署与可审计执行在架构层面共同设计。该模型将碎片化企业知识转化为一种可审计、可执行的企业智能层，目标是解决安全合规与真实业务流程自动化的难题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04377v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise AI deployments fail not from model inadequacy, but because organizations lack a structured substrate encoding how they decide, negotiate, and execute. Generic LLMs carry no firm-specific ontological priors; RAG remains brittle, with no path to executable action; static playbooks encode logic but cannot reason or adapt. This demands an architecture treating tacit-knowledge capture, ontological grounding, sovereign deployment, and auditable actuation as co-designed from the start. This paper introduces the Corporate Language Model (CLM),…
items.why_zh: 该架构直接回应了企业大模型落地中最关键的治理难题，希望让AI在业务流程中既可用又可解释、可追责。
items.why_en: It tackles the fundamental reason enterprise AI fails by making company knowledge structured, auditable, and actionable in an AI-native way.

items.title_zh: PerfReasoning：大语言模型在硬件性能推理上表现如何？
items.title_en: PerfReasoning: How Well Do LLMs Reason on Hardware Performance?
items.summary_zh: 性能建模是硬件设计与软件优化的关键，但建立模型通常需要对计算、数据复用、存储和数据搬运等做结构化推理。本文提出PerfReasoning基准，用来全面评估大语言模型（LLM）在这类任务上的能力，包括直接进行性能推理和生成解析式性能模型代码。给定工作负载、架构和映射规格后，模型需要比较不同映射方案，并预测片外流量与缓冲区需求。实验显示，最强的闭源模型在基于推理的问答上可以超过90%的准确率，展示了大模型在硬件性能分析中的潜力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04476v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Performance modeling is central to hardware design and software optimization, yet constructing these models requires structured reasoning about computation, data reuse, storage, and movement. We introduce PerfReasoning, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs both as direct performance reasoners and as generators of analytical performance-model code. Given workload, architecture, and mapping specifications, models compare mappings and predict off-chip traffic and buffer requirements. The strongest closed-source models exceed 90% on reasoning-based Q&A, a…
items.why_zh: 它是首个系统化考察LLM硬件性能推理能力的基准，有助于推动芯片设计与软硬件优化走向智能化。
items.why_en: It is a new benchmark that quantifies LLM performance reasoning, which could support automated hardware design and optimization.

items.title_zh: BioSync：基于Transformer的跨模态融合，构建多模态生理数字生物标志物
items.title_en: BioSync: Transformer-Based Cross-Modal Fusion for a Multimodal Physiological Digital Biomarker
items.summary_zh: 心脏、神经、行为和语音等来自可穿戴和移动设备的测量，只能提供零散且对噪声敏感的生理状态信息。BioSync将不同模态测量融合为连续复合数字生物标志物BioSync指数（BSI），其定义遵循BEST框架。在技术实现上，模型通过对模态标记施加多头自注意力，来捕捉跨模态的关系；同时加入一个线性分支，保证假设空间至少覆盖标准特征拼接这类简单基线。作者认为，这种设计受潜变量测量理论启发，并有望让联合多模态信号更稳定地刻画人体状态。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cardiac, neural, behavioral, and speech measurements from wearable and mobile devices provide partial, noise-sensitive views of physiological state. BioSync combines these measurements into the \textbf{BioSync Index (BSI)}, a continuous composite digital biomarker defined under the BEST framework. The model applies multi-head self-attention to modality tokens and adds a linear branch whose hypothesis class includes standard feature concatenation. This architecture is motivated by latent-variable measurement theory and by the possibility that join…
items.why_zh: 它提供了一种可扩展的通用方法来融合可穿戴设备的多模态信号，为连续健康监护输出更可靠的数字生物标志物。
items.why_en: It shows how transformers can merge noisy physiological signals into a robust digital biomarker for real-world health monitoring.

items.title_zh: 迈向通用概念语言：一项综述
items.title_en: Towards a universal language of concepts: A survey
items.summary_zh: 人类之所以能仅凭少量实例就学习并推广新概念，是因为常常以丰富的结构化形式表达知识。本文作者提出，程序是一种很有潜力的通用概念表征语言。他们系统梳理了以程序作为概念表示的多种计算模型，并评估这类方法对实现通用表示语言这一目标的贡献。这些研究试图利用程序的模块化组合能力来表征概念，让学习到的知识具备可解释和可重用的结构，从而向通用表示语言靠拢。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Humans can learn and generalize novel concepts from sparse data because they express knowledge in rich structural formats. In this paper, we propose that programs are a strong candidate for universal representation of concepts. We review computational models of concept learning that use programs as their concept representation and evaluate their contribution toward a universal representational language.
items.why_zh: 它为AI概念学习指出了一条新路线，即使用可执行、可组合的程序而非传统表征去表达抽象知识，有望提升样本效率与可解释性。
items.why_en: It consolidates evidence for using programs as a universal concept representation, a direction that could make AI learning more systematic and interpretable.

items.title_zh: IPGeoAI：基于Transformer的地理定位与LLM语义融合
items.title_en: IPGeoAI: Transformer-Based Geolocation with LLM Semantic Fusion
items.summary_zh: 城市级IP地理定位是现代互联网服务的重要基础，支撑本地内容分发、精准定向、数字版权保护等应用。然而传统启发式规则和数据库方法难以应对网络地址分配的非线性规律，尤其是IPv6地址空间快速扩张和移动网络临时分配带来的挑战。本文提出IPGeoAI，一种新型深度学习架构，将IP地理定位纳入Transformer框架，并引入大语言模型语义融合以捕捉复杂映射。该方法旨在解决传统方法在动态、大地址池场景下定位不准的问题，提高城市级定位的准确性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04559v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate city-level IP Geolocation is an important enabler for the modern digital ecosystem, underpinning services ranging from local content delivery and targeting to digital rights enforcement. However, traditional heuristic and database-driven methods often struggle to resolve the complex, non-linear allocation patterns of modern network infrastructures, particularly within the exploding IPv6 address space and transient mobile networks. In this paper, we introduce IPGeoAI, a novel deep learning model architecture that reframes geolocation from…
items.why_zh: 它将LLM语义信息引入IP定位任务，有望显著改善动态网络环境下的城市级定位精度，服务定向分发和安全合规。
items.why_en: It leverages LLM semantics to improve IP geolocation in modern, dynamic network environments, supporting location-based content and security.

items.title_zh: 所选对象能到达读者吗？对接地语言模型流程中身份交接的审计
items.title_en: Does the Selected Object Reach the Reader? Auditing Identity Handoffs in Grounded Language-Model Pipelines
items.summary_zh: 接地语言模型（grounded LM）管道通常需要经历三个环节：先选出一个对象，再检索该对象的文档片段，最后基于这些证据作答。如果最初选定的对象在中途丢失，前后交接就会断裂，而现有基准的召回率通常只检查数据集关联对象是否出现，未必能发现该类问题。作者为此开展审计，覆盖了600道HybridQA问题中的三个选择器家族；在1463条可解析记录上，当选择对象与数据集追踪段落一致时，精确键查找和精确标题匹配都能百分百保留该对象。文章还进一步分析不同排序规则对身份交接的影响，展示了如何系统定位这一潜在失效环节。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04579v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grounded language-model pipelines can be divided into three stages: selecting an object, retrieving passages for it, and using that evidence to answer. If the selected object must reach the reader, losing it breaks the handoff. Benchmark recall checks the dataset-linked object, which can differ. We audit 600 HybridQA questions across three selector families. On 1,463 resolvable records where the selected object matches the dataset-traced passage, exact key lookup and exact title matching return the object every time. With every ranked rule given…
items.why_zh: 它为接地的LLM问答流程提供了一种针对中间环节的身份追踪审计方法，有助于避免答案引用错误实体。
items.why_en: It provides a method for auditing whether grounded LM pipelines preserve the intended object through retrieval and reasoning—critical for trustworthy QA.

items.title_zh: ERPBench：评估企业决策LLM代理在竞争市场生态中的表现
items.title_en: ERPBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Enterprise Decision-Making Across Competitive Market Ecologies
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型代理逐渐被用于企业工作流，但现有评估很少检验商业决策结论能否跨竞争市场生态迁移。为此，研究者推出ERPBench，一个面向企业决策代理的执行级检测基准，基于六轮企业资源规划（ERP）模拟，涵盖定价、生产、采购、库存、财务及共享市场竞争。该基准在两个匹配的竞争市场生态中评估相同的100个固定问题，以比较不同环境下代理的决策表现。该工作填补了企业级LLM评估中缺乏跨生态迁移测试的空白，为构建更鲁棒的企业决策智能提供了评测基础。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04667v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed for enterprise workflows, yet existing evaluations rarely test whether business-decision conclusions transfer across competitive market ecologies. We introduce ERPBench, an execution-instrumented benchmark for enterprise decision agents in a six-round Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) simulation with coupled pricing, production, procurement, inventory, finance, and shared-market competition. ERPBench evaluates the same 100 fixed problems in two matched competitive market ecologies: Solo…
items.why_zh: 它是首个在竞争市场生态间检验企业决策可迁移性的LLM代理基准。
items.why_en: It is the first benchmark that tests whether LLM agents' business decisions transfer across competitive market ecologies.

items.title_zh: 基于移动感知和低秩自适应图神经网络的PM2.5时空浓度预测
items.title_en: Predicting Spatiotemporal Mobile Sensing-Based PM2.5 Concentrations Using Low-Rank Adapted Spatially Attentive Graph Neural Network
items.summary_zh: 城市空气污染在交通沿线变化显著，需高分辨率监测。研究者引入来自印度古吉拉特邦苏拉特市的新移动传感数据集，包含PM2.5浓度、气象变量（温度、湿度、风速、风向）及土地利用特征。为将时空数据表示为图，采用了两种节点定义策略：均匀分段（200–400米间隔）和DBSCAN聚类以自适应聚合密集观测。结合低秩自适应与空间注意力图神经网络建模时空相关性，从而提升PM2.5预测准确性。这项工作为城市交通走廊的高分辨率污染监测提供了可扩展方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Urban air quality can vary significantly along transit corridors, necessitating high-resolution monitoring. This work introduces a novel mobile-sensing dataset from Surat, Gujarat, India, comprising PM$*{2.5}$ concentrations, meteorological variables (temperature, humidity, wind speed, wind direction), and land-use features. To represent the spatiotemporal data as a graph, two node-definition strategies were used: (i) uniform segmentation (200--400~m intervals) and (ii) DBSCAN clustering to adaptively group dense observations. For each node, roll…
items.why_zh: 该研究提供了一套新数据集和高效模型，支持城市交通沿线的高分辨率空气质量精细监测。
items.why_en: It enables high-resolution urban air-quality monitoring with a new dataset and efficient graph-based model.

items.title_zh: 模型退役给生物医学AI研究带来可重复性风险
items.title_en: Model Retirement Creates Reproducibility Risk in Biomedical AI Publications
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型在生物医学研究中的应用正在加速，但托管许多常用模型的商业服务有着弃用时间表，可能危及科学可重复性。为量化这一风险，研究者检索了PubMed从2022年至2026年3月、将特定LLM应用于生物医学任务的原创研究，共识别61,077篇摘要。他们使用提取代理识别模型名称，并由人工评审员对其进行抽取准确性验证。结果表明，许多可复现实验依赖的模型版本可能随时间退役，导致后续研究难以复用原文设置。论文呼吁期刊与研究者关注模型版本锁定与归档，以保障生物医学AI的可重复性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Background. Large language models (LLMs) are being adopted in biomedical research at a rapid and accelerating pace, yet commercial services that host many widely used models operate under deprecation schedules that can complicate scientific reproducibility. Methods. We searched PubMed for original research articles from 2022 through March 2026 that applied a specific LLM to a biomedical task. An extraction agent identified model names from 61,077 article abstracts with human reviewers validating a subset for extraction accuracy. Extracted model n…
items.why_zh: 它首次大规模揭示了商业模型退役对生物医学可重复性的系统性风险，推动建立模型归档机制。
items.why_en: It highlights the overlooked problem of model retirement in biomedical AI and urges archival solutions for reproducibility.

items.title_zh: Aplaud：用户特定LLM的自适应个性化低秩分解
items.title_en: Aplaud: Adaptive Personalized Low-Rank Decomposition for User-Specific LLM
items.summary_zh: 针对利用微调大语言模型进行个性化调查响应预测的问题，本文提出Aplaud框架，以应对单用户训练数据少、模型存储扩展难以及要开发跨调查题共享结构等挑战。Aplaud扩展了LoRA方法，将适应过程分离为冻结的共享低秩部分与用户特定的动态部分，从而在保持轻量化的同时实现个性化。该框架能有效利用不同题目之间的共享特征，并仅需少量每用户参数即可快速适配。结果表明，这种自适应低秩分解为大规模用户个性化提供了一种可扩展且高效的解决方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04738v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of personalized survey response prediction using fine-tuned large language models (LLMs). This task poses unique challenges: limited per-user training data, scalability of model storage, and the need to exploit shared structure across survey questions. To address these issues, we propose Aplaud (Adaptive Personalized Low-rank and User-specific Nested Decomposition), a lightweight and scalable framework for LLM personalization. Aplaud extends the LoRA paradigm by separating adaptation into a frozen, shared low-r…
items.why_zh: 这一方法让大模型在服务海量个体时能高效完成轻量、可扩展的个性化，兼顾共享与个人特征。
items.why_en: It offers a scalable and lightweight recipe for user-specific LLM personalization under data scarcity.

items.title_zh: 扩散语言模型助力移动边缘具身AI代理：基础、应用与挑战
items.title_en: Diffusion Language Models for Mobile Edge Agentic AI: Foundations, Applications, and Challenges
items.summary_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）提供了一种非自回归的替代方案，通过迭代去噪而非从左到右解码来精炼词元，适用于移动边缘代理型AI。与基于自回归Transformer的大模型不同，DLM可并行更新多个不确定词元并在生成全程利用双向上下文，从而在质量与延迟之间实现更灵活的权衡。这些特性特别适合边缘代理场景，因为设备计算能力和能耗受限，同时需要快速响应。文章系统梳理了DLM的数学原理、关键机制、典型应用（如移动端的智能助手和请求调度）及开放挑战。它为边缘智能代理模型选型提供了有价值的路线图。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04778v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a non-autoregressive alternative for mobile edge agentic artificial intelligence (AI) by refining tokens through iterative denoising rather than left-to-right decoding. Compared with autoregressive Transformer-based large language models (LLMs), DLMs can update multiple uncertain tokens in parallel and exploit bidirectional context throughout the generation process, enabling more flexible quality-latency trade-offs beyond fixed sequential decoding. These properties are particularly attractive for edge agents…
items.why_zh: DLM的自回归替代特性为资源受限的边缘设备提供了更灵活的质量-延迟权衡，可能重塑移动代理AI架构。
items.why_en: It highlights how non-autoregressive diffusion can deliver flexible quality-latency trade-offs essential for edge AI agents.

items.title_zh: DODR：潜空间中的确定性算子驱动推理
items.title_en: DODR: Deterministic Operator-Driven Reasoning in Latent Space
items.summary_zh: 自回归大模型将推理视为基于词元级别的概率采样，这给复杂逻辑推理带来三个根本缺陷：错误累积、概率替代必然性以及线性链信息瓶颈。为此，论文提出确定性算子驱动潜空间推理架构（DODR），将推理重构为高维线性代数空间中的推理图计算。其中推理状态被表示成快照向量，其基本原语由可组合的确定性算子构成，从而避免概率采样的不确定性。通过将推理过程符号化和结构化，DODR有望提升复杂推理的可控性和稳定性。这项研究为超越自回归范式提供了新的推理计算视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04782v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) large language models formulate reasoning as token-level probabilistic sampling, which induces three fundamental defects in complex logical reasoning: error accumulation, probability substituting necessity, and the linear-chain information bottleneck. This paper proposes the Deterministic Operator-Driven Reasoning in Latent Space architecture (DODR), which reconstructs reasoning as reasoning-graph computation in a high-dimensional linear-algebraic space. Reasoning states are represented as snapshot vectors whose primitives are…
items.why_zh: 它提出了一种完全确定性的潜空间推理范式，绕开了自回归概率采样的固有限制，可能提升复杂逻辑推理能力。
items.why_en: It offers a paradigm shift from probabilistic token sampling to deterministic latent-space reasoning, addressing key autoregressive deficiencies.

items.title_zh: 当金融微调失效：领域适应语言模型数字幻觉的三级可检测性分析
items.title_en: When Financial Fine-tuning Fails: A Three-Level Detectability Analysis of Numerical Hallucination in Domain-Adapted Language Models
items.summary_zh: 金融大模型越来越多地被用于报告与披露文件的摘要生成，而数字幻觉会带来严重的实际风险。过去研究常把这种幻觉归因于数值推理能力不足，但这一假设尚未在受控微调条件下被系统性检验。本文对此进行了低成本、受控研究，涉及多种模型变体，包括基础指令微调模型、领域语言适应模型等，聚焦财务摘要任务。分析从三个层级考察数字幻觉的可检测性，揭示不同微调方式对幻觉出现与识别的影响。结果为部署金融LLM的企业提供了重要的可检测性与风险管控见解。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04806v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Financial large language models are increasingly deployed for summarization of reports and disclosures, where numerical hallucination poses significant practical risks. While prior work often attributes such hallucination to insufficient numerical reasoning, this assumption has not been systematically tested under controlled fine-tuning settings. In this paper, we conduct a cost-effective, controlled study of numerical hallucination in financial summarization across three model variants: a base instruction-tuned model, a domain language-adapted m…
items.why_zh: 这项研究揭示数字幻觉与微调方式及可检测性的复杂关系，提醒金融机构在部署领域微调模型时仍需警惕。
items.why_en: It shows that numerical hallucination in financial LLMs cannot be attributed solely to reasoning deficits and must be assessed across fine-tuning settings.

items.title_zh: 面向多站点工业预测性维护的长时程Transformer分位数故障预测
items.title_en: Long Horizon Transformer Quantile Fault Prediction for Multi Site Industrial Predictive Maintenance
items.summary_zh: 长期预测性维护要求模型能够在数天而非数小时的规划窗口内，区分缓慢演化的退化与正常工况变化。本论文探讨显式条件分位数表示能否为该问题提供有效的分类器接口。所提出的TQRNN30d框架结合了双阶段分位数回归神经网络（QRNN）特征提取器与多流时间融合分类器。每小时的81通道机器行为数据被映射为特征，供模型长期预测故障概率。该方法旨在提升多站点工业场景下预测性维护的提前预警能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon predictive maintenance requires models to distinguish slowly evolving degradation from normal operating-regime variation over planning windows measured in days rather than hours. This paper evaluates whether an explicit conditional-quantile representation provides an informative classifier interface for this problem. The proposed TQRNN30d framework combines a dual-stage quantile regression neural network (QRNN) feature extractor with a multi-stream temporal fusion classifier. Each hourly word of 81-channel machine behaviour is mapped…
items.why_zh: 该框架针对跨日尺度的退化建模，可改善复杂工业环境中的提前故障预警与维护计划。
items.why_en: It improves early fault warning in industrial settings by capturing long-horizon degradation dynamics.

items.title_zh: MM-IFEval-Pro：面向视觉语言模型的多语言与抗攻击指令跟随基准
items.title_en: MM-IFEval-Pro: A Multilingual and Attack-Resistant Benchmark for Instruction-Following in Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 随着视觉语言模型（VLM）在图像理解、跨模态推理和复杂指令执行方面的快速进步，指令跟随能力已成为衡量其可靠性与实用性的重要指标。然而，现有相关基准存在语言覆盖有限、对抗性安全场景不足等缺陷，难以评估真实世界中多语言及安全敏感场景下的模型表现。为此，作者提出MM-IFEval-Pro，一个多语言、抗攻击的多模态指令跟随基准，旨在填补这一评测空白。该基准有望推动VLM在更多语言与对抗性条件下的能力验证，为模型部署前的安全性和可用性评估提供新工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04859v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As vision-language models (VLMs) rapidly advance in image understanding, cross-modal reasoning, and complex instruction execution, instruction-following capability has become a key indicator of their reliability and practicality. However, existing multimodal instruction-following benchmarks still suffer from limited language coverage and insufficient adversarial safety scenarios, making them inadequate for evaluating real-world multilingual and safety-sensitive settings. To address these gaps, we present MM-IFEval-Pro, a multimodal instruction-fo…
items.why_zh: 该基准补上了VLM指令跟随评测在多语言与对抗安全维度的短板，有助于在真实场景中检验模型的可靠与安全。
items.why_en: MM-IFEval-Pro addresses the lack of multilingual and adversarial evaluation for instruction-following in VLMs, helping to assess reliability in safety-sensitive real-world settings.

items.title_zh: 从交互痕迹到持久技能：计算机使用代理的在线进化
items.title_en: From Interaction Traces to Persistent Skills: Online Evolution for Computer-Use Agents
items.summary_zh: 计算机使用代理虽能处理图形界面中的复杂任务，但其交互经验往往是暂时的：某次操作得到的程序性知识无法被系统保留、提炼并复用于后续任务。现有技能库能提供外部过程知识，但这些知识相对于不借助技能库的代理带来的增量价值，以及反复交互后的纵向演化特征，仍未得到充分刻画。为此，研究者提出在线技能进化框架，让代理从交互痕迹中不断学习，并把经验转化为可跨任务使用的持久技能。这一方向有望解决AI代理经验难以积累和复用的问题，提升其在真实软件环境中的长期自主能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computer-use agents can execute increasingly complex tasks in graphical interfaces, but their interaction experience is typically transient: procedural knowledge acquired from one rollout is not systematically retained, refined, and reused in later tasks. Existing skill libraries provide external procedural knowledge, yet their incremental value over the same agent operating without skills, as well as their longitudinal dynamics under repeated interaction, remain insufficiently characterized. We present an online skill-evolution framework that co…
items.why_zh: 这项研究试图解决计算机代理“用过即忘”的局限，通过将交互经验固化为可复用技能，为代理的长期自主进化奠基。
items.why_en: It tackles the transient nature of agent experience by enabling persistent skills, a crucial step for AI agents to improve continuously across tasks.

items.title_zh: MARLA：支撑欧盟《人工智能法案》监管学习的概念框架
items.title_en: MARLA: A Conceptual Scaffold for Regulatory Learning under the EU AI Act
items.summary_zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》将监管定位为安全、可信与市场化创新的基础设施，而这需要“监管学习”以把实施过程中产生的证据转化为治理和法律知识，从而支持一致解释、有效监督和技术变化下的适应性。但证据生产者与使用者分属不同专业场域，知识难以自然流通。为了弥补这一断裂，论文提出MARLA（Map, Assess, Report, Learn, Adapt）概念框架，用五个环节为监管证据的生成、转化与迭代提供系统性指引。该框架有助于打通技术实践与法律监管间的知识通道，为AI法案的动态落地提供制度参考。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The EU AI Act positions regulation as part of the infrastructure for safe, trustworthy and market-ready innovation. Realising this ambition requires regulatory learning: the evidence generated during implementation must be translated into governance and legal knowledge that supports consistent interpretation, effective oversight, and adaptation as technologies evolve. items.why_zh: 该框架为欧盟AI法案“边实施边学习”提供了路线图，有利于不同专业世界共同应对快速演进的AI技术。
items.why_en: It offers a structured way to operationalize regulatory learning under the EU AI Act, helping bridge technical implementers and legal overseers.

items.title_zh: 不确定性下太阳能光伏政策的序列式设计：基于强化学习与多智能体模拟的方法
items.title_en: Reinforcement Learning for Sequential Solar PV Policy Design under Uncertainty: An Agent-Based Approach
items.summary_zh: 太阳能光伏（PV）推广政策既要追求采用规模增长，又要在不确定性、异质决策主体面前控制公共支出，因此设计起来非常困难。该研究将政策设计表述为顺序决策问题，并把强化学习与随机多智能体模型相耦合，用以模拟不确定性环境下的年度光伏采用。一个政策智能体可以逐年选择资本补贴、贴息贷款利率、上网电价等激励措施，在16年周期内动态调整政策组合，以在采用收益和财政可持续之间取得平衡。该框架展示了强化学习在长期、动态且充满不确定性的公共政策设计中发挥作用的可能性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04880v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing effective and fiscally sustainable policies for solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption requires balancing adoption gains against public expenditure under uncertainty and heterogeneous decision-making. items.why_zh: 它提供了一种在不确定条件下动态调整可再生能源激励政策的方法，有助于提升公共决策的适应性与财政可持续性。
items.why_en: By combining RL with agent-based modeling, it enables adaptive, financially sustainable solar policy design under uncertainty, with implications for real-world energy transition.

items.title_zh: 从语言模型到改变世界的系统：智能体AI在数字、社会、虚拟与物理环境中的进展与边界
items.title_en: From Language Models to World-Acting Systems: Progress and Limits of Agentic AI across Digital, Social, Virtual, and Physical Environments
items.summary_zh: 随着与外部环境连接的增强，大语言模型已从文本处理器发展为能改变外部状态的行动者：它们可以调用工具、操作软件界面、安排和委派任务、维持内部状态、参与生成的虚拟世界，也能控制机器人或实验室设备。不过，业界常用“迈向自主”的单一进步叙事来描述这些能力，容易将模型能力、系统整合、持久性与安全授权等不同议题混为一谈。该篇批判性综述基于截至2026年8月31日的主要研究和官方技术规范，围绕“委托”等维度梳理证据，勾勒出AI代理在数字、社会、虚拟与物理环境中的能力限度和待解问题。它为透明地区分自主性声称和实际能力提供了一份难得的全景图。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.04894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models become consequential agents when surrounding systems let outputs change external state. Models now call tools, operate interfaces, delegate work, retain state, inhabit generated worlds, and control robots or laboratory equipment. items.why_zh: 在AI代理被授予越来越多外部控制权的背景下，该综述有助于厘清“自主性”的多重含义，避免过度炒作并助力安全负责的部署。
items.why_en: As AI agents gain power to act on the world, this review clarifies distinct facets of autonomy and helps separate genuine progress from exaggerated claims.
